objects.name: Analytic 1855
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an unsigned or unexpected process calling Windows hooking Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) (SetWindowsHookEx, SetWinEventHook) targeting an Industrial Control System (ICS) engineering or Human-Machine Interface (HMI) process, immediately followed by that target process loading a Dynamic Link Library (DLL) not present in the vendor's signed module baseline. Confirmed in the wild: Stuxnet replaced Siemens' s7otbxdx.dll on engineering workstations to intercept and falsify Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) read/write calls between WinCC/STEP7 and the controller. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
